{"notes": "Visit 5 (left at 7:00). Nobody spoke while I was there, so I'm still crediting only what people said earlier and what the picture shows. I still don't know who placed which domino.

State of the build: the outline is closed and continuous from the start through top line, belly and rounded tail, all dark (connected). Unchanged since visit 3: one pale, unconnected domino at the top-line dip near (20.3, 7.8), harmless to the chain if it stays disconnected, and a crowded, possibly doubled-up tail/belly join around x 23-26, y 13.3, a risk for the push. No hands on the picture, so the team is holding to hands off.

Sofia: Not seen or heard. Jack credits her with the tail, which fits her plan. Her visit 2 promise to inspect the join is still not visibly paid off. Collaboration and communication strong, execution good but not perfect.

Omar: Not seen or heard. He cleared strays at the dip earlier, yet one remains. Can't tell if he ran out of time or missed it. Visit 2 ownership stands. Ask him in the review.

Hana: Not seen or heard. Her 'hands off until the push' call was sensible, but 'looks solid' missed the stray and crowded join. No direct evidence of her building. Visit 1 leadership stands.

Jack: Not seen or heard. Earlier he was gracious, credited others and kept hands off. No evidence of what he built. Ask him directly. Collaboration positive, impact and execution unknown.

For the review: ask each person what they placed and who fixed what. Don't rate anyone on the push result alone, since I can't attribute the outcome to individuals."}
